title: Steel and Cedar

unitTypes.name: Commander Rowan Vale
unitTypes.notes: ALLIED COMMANDER: persistent protect target and visual anchor for the shared commander treatment.

unitTypes.name: Lord Masatora
unitTypes.notes: FINAL BOSS COMMANDER: named visual anchor for the shared boss treatment.

objectives.name: Hold Cedar Watch for twenty rounds

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: The treaty bell rang from an abandoned orchard. Someone wants the March to answer with steel.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: Then we reach the bell before a frightened patrol becomes a war.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Stay close. We learn who gave the order, and we leave witnesses alive to refute it.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: Use the road to close the distance. I can mend you, but only if I can reach you.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: We focus one threat at a time, then end the turn together.

lines.speaker: Akari
lines.text: Cedar heard the same false signal. Ren and I will hold the lower road while you take the bell.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: Two armies, two approaches. If either route folds, the other one gets surrounded.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: Their purses carry coins from both courts.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Then this is not a border mistake. The courier trail enters Cedar Deepwood.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: The old track is narrow. The archers can watch a clearing without standing inside it.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: We clear the near ambush, use the rock line as cover, and reach the eastern courier.

lines.speaker: Akari
lines.text: My company begins on the southern trail. We can cut the courier off beyond the cedar wall.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: Do not hurry to meet us. Win your route first; we rendezvous at the watch road.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Vere's seal orders the March to burn Cedar villages.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: And the captured courier carried Masatora's matching order. Each court is feeding the other's fear.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Cedar Watch can show both capitals the same signal. We hold it long enough for both to answer.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: The relay needs twenty rounds to reach both capitals.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: I stay with the signal. Watch the four approaches and never chase a wave past the next entry path.

lines.speaker: Akari
lines.text: Cedar holds the eastern steps. Rowan, keep the western court and the commander line intact.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: We will trade warnings across the courtyard. Neither front is a reserve for the other.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: Both capitals answered. The lie is exposed.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Vere is barricading Gate Village with the treaty record. We take the streets before he burns it.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: The north gate reaches the square quickly, but the alleys leave no room to turn.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: The south lane is longer and safer. Keep the houses between us and their archers.

lines.speaker: Akari
lines.text: Cedar enters by the south lane and cuts off Vere's escape.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: The square is our rendezvous. Until then, each army owns its own street fight.

lines.speaker: Vere
lines.text: Masatora never wanted a partner. The Twin Gate is his now.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: The record survives you. I will carry it to the gate and end this before either realm can deny it.

lines.speaker: Masatora
lines.text: One gate, one law, one hand on the sword. That is peace that lasts.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: That is fear made permanent. The gate opens for both realms, or for neither.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: The side stairs avoid the glaive, but his reserves will close them behind us.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: We break each guard post, converge on Masatora, and keep the treaty record standing with me.

lines.speaker: Akari
lines.text: Rowan takes the high stair. I take the lower court. We meet at Masatora with both armies intact.

lines.speaker: Ren
lines.text: Separate openings, one finish. Neither route can wait for the other to do the work.

lines.speaker: Akari
lines.text: Cedar heard the truth from its own soldiers, not from a foreign court.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: And the March heard it from mine. That is how this peace begins.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: The March sent a new bell for the gate tower.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Hang it beside Cedar's drum. One signal should never command two realms in secret again.

lines.speaker: Tomas
lines.text: The road is still here, even if we lost it today.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Then we remember where the line broke and take it again.

notes: A five-battle Medieval-and-Sengoku campaign designed as the future common demo. One player follows Commander Rowan and Tomas through a complete story. With two local players, Akari and Ren arrive as a separate Cedar army with their own dialogue, deployment fronts, route responsibilities and additional opposition. The compact opening teaches the rules; four larger boards exercise scrolling, split routes, rendezvous decisions, a twenty-round commander defense, a village assault and a final boss while staying within console encounter budgets.
